citation.description: register() appends five MetricSpec entries (bug_close_class_by_month, bug_time_to_close_days, bug_open_age_days, bug_detected_by_distribution, bug_caused_by_fan_in) to REGISTRY with lens='bug_trends', source='structural', confidence='high', idempotent by id. register() is called at module level (line 353). The module is side-effect imported in src/rebar/metrics/__init__.py line 18.

criteria.criterion: 'rebar metrics' exposes a bug_trends lens with the five dimensions, registered via the standard registry pattern.

citation.description: Line 148: cls = row['close_class'] if row['close_class'] is not None else 'MISSING' — null close_class becomes the literal key 'MISSING' in the month bucket, never dropped. Confirmed by test_close_class_by_month_labels_missing_cohort and test_all_missing_month_is_labeled_not_dropped in the test files.

criteria.criterion: Pre-convention MISSING close_class is surfaced as a labeled cohort, never silently dropped or merged.

citation.description: _derive_detected_by_distribution returns None when no bug carries detected_by (line 191-192). Other dimensions have independent compute functions and are unaffected. test_absent_detected_by_degrades_only_that_dimension in test_bug_trends_heldout.py confirms independence.

criteria.criterion: Sparse/absent detected_by degrades that dimension to unavailable without affecting others.

citation.description: test_bug_trends.py covers populated/mixed-era stores (6 tests including MISSING cohort, percentiles, clock seam, descending fan-in, registry ids). test_bug_trends_heldout.py covers empty tracker (test_all_dimensions_none_on_empty_tracker), missing tracker (test_all_dimensions_none_when_tracker_missing), and mixed-era (test_missing_never_merged_into_a_real_class, test_all_missing_month_is_labeled_not_dropped). Both files present and non-stub.

criteria.criterion: Unit tests cover populated, empty, and mixed-era stores.
